author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
Unlock an approach to product mockups, inspired by a working graphic designer. Badal Patel, founder of Super Spicy studio, uses a combination of Adobe Firefly, Photoshop, and Illustrator. Watch as she takes nail polish brand, Static, into the Firefly studio to kick off design concept, shifts to Photoshop to edit and refine the vision, and drops her final Illustrator-made logo to seal the deal. She’s communicating with clients and bringing her creative vision with clarity and precision.
